scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them to the old chapel for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago, the night the bell first rang, with warm water. She offers a ride at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The warm, candle-wax-smelling tunnel floods thirty paces in, with wet hymn-book pages floating on the water. Teo finds a page with 'M. Brand' pencilled in the margin and recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya speculate that harbor-master Maren is in the cult; Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The bell rings at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning; fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under water, the humming is much louder than two nights ago, and pale congregation-like shapes appear on the chapel floor before vanishing. The party flees.

scenes.title: Plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide by day, with Sela rowing them at first light. Innkeeper Bram gives them free stew and says he has known harbor-master Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. They take a long rest and the session ends.
